company.shortDescription: Quan is a healthtech company that offers an end-to-end self assesment platform for improving employee wellbeing and team performance.
company.description: Quan worked diligently with psychologists and therapists to develop a well-being assessment focused on improving “self-awareness” and helping individuals identify the areas which need attention across their personal and work lives.
